about: The places each search answer in this folder gives, in order, in both apps. nominatim-*.json are Nominatim /search answers recorded on 12 Nov 2026 (format=jsonv2, addressdetails=1, limit=20, countrycodes=za,ls,sz,na,bw,zw,mz); photon-sabi-sand.json is Photon's answer for the same reserve, written by hand in Photon's format because Photon was down: its coordinates and extent are copied from the Nominatim answer, so only id, name, kind, tag and region are compared between the two services (replace it with a recorded Photon answer once Photon is back). The first Nominatim pass for a map in lat -35.5..-10.3, lon 11.5..41 uses countrycodes=za,ls,sz,na,bw,zw,mz,zm,mw,ao,cd,tz (every country that box reaches); the fixtures were recorded with the first seven, and give the same places. extent is [minLat, minLon, maxLat, maxLon], null for a spot.
